messages:
Tara (Design): quick design QA — noticed the collapsed Network diagnostics card in Private setup shows "Issue detected" but no clear next action. Screenshot attached. Can we surface a clearer action and fix focus/announce behavior? Eli (PM): Agree. Also the primary action is hidden in the overflow menu today. Can we surface a primary button like "Retry probes"? Monica (Eng): a11y note: keyboard focus doesn't land correctly on the collapsed header sometimes. Pressing Enter toggles but the focus outline disappears. Also the status updates inside the card aren't announced. Josh (SRE): +1 to surfacing the action. Ops prefers the verb "Retry probes" over "Run again" — clearer. Tara (Design): microcopy proposals: - summary: "Issue detected" -> "Network checks found an issue" - primary action: "Run again" -> "Retry probes" - helper hint: "If failures persist, check firewall rules and outbound egress to cloud.redwood.ai:443" Would also like to add a short status pill like "Failed (3)" instead of plain red text. Monica (Eng): Implementation + accessibility suggestion — add an aria-live region for status and ensure the collapse toggle uses aria-expanded. Example: ```html
All checks passed
``` Also fyi we'll need to adjust focus styles so keyboard outlines remain visible after toggle. a11y-bot: Recommend aria-live="polite" on the summary region and ensure any count changes include the numeric value (e.g., "Failed (3)") for screen reader clarity. Add aria-label to the retry button: "Retry network probes". Eli (PM): product question — if a user clicks "Retry probes", should the card auto-expand to show detailed results when failures happen? I lean toward auto-expand so users immediately see which hosts/ports failed. Josh (SRE): auto-expand = good. Also make the retry button disabled while probes are in-flight and show a spinner to avoid duplicate retries. We should also surface a small troubleshooting link: "Help: common firewall rules" that opens a KB. Monica (Eng): tech note: we'll need a debounce and server-side rate limit for retries. We'll return a probe job id and front-end should poll with exponential backoff. I'll add the i18n keys we should use: `wizard.network.checks.summary_issue`, `wizard.network.actions.retry`, `wizard.network.hint.egress` Tara (Design): I'll iterate mocks with the pill + retry primary + helper link + visible focus. Also will update the copy in the spec and attach new screenshots. Thanks! :thumbsup: Eli (PM): I'll create a follow-up ticket for analytics: event `wizard_network_retry` with properties `{ outcome, retry_count, job_id }`. Tara (Design): small UX nits to track: tooltip text for ambiguous errors should be short (max 90 chars), avoid passive voice, and include an inline "What this means" link for netops. Will post updated copy in the ticket.
